ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with localized high-intensity (white) pixels; approximate ratio of 9:1 dark-to-light surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light-grey/white circular annular rings and thin linear streaks distributed across a uniform dark background; high spatial density of circular formations on the distal ends of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 70 degrees; depth extends significantly into the central fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary featuring irregular peaks and shallow valleys; serration frequency is high along the medial-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity transitioning from the peduncle base to the lateral tips of both fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of distinct white circular rings and oval shapes (annular pixel patterns) concentrated on the left distal tip and scattered across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions (scratches) mapped across the central and lower regions of the fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acquired scarring manifest as numerous white annular/circular lesions across the ventral surface, likely associated with parasitic or barnacle attachment.
